scripts.db:apply: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file migrations/0001_init/migration.sql
scripts.db:bootstrap: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file migrations/0000_bootstrap/bootstrap.sql
scripts.db:diff: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
scripts.db:grants: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file migrations/0002_app_grants/migration.sql
scripts.db:pull: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db pull && prisma format
scripts.db:smoke: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db execute --schema prisma/schema.prisma --file tests/schema_smoke.sql
scripts.test: echo 'schema tests run via pnpm db:smoke against a live database' && exit 0
